name: Lisa Jane Colyer
who: Founder and Direct Coggeshall Road Alternative Provision
quote: We had an excellent experience working with Karla at Bright Futures Recruitment, who recently placed our English Lead with us. From the outset, she took the time to fully understand our business needs and provided a high-quality, well-matched candidate. They have settled in quickly and are already proving to be a valuable addition to the team, both professionally and culturally. The entire process was smooth, efficient, and well managed, with excellent communication throughout. We would not hesitate to recommend Bright Futures Recruitment and would happily work with them again in the future.
